prompt: Why does nitrogen have a lower electron affinity than carbon?
answer: N's 2p is half filled, so the added electron must pair in an occupied orbital. Electron-electron repulsion means less energy is released. C has an empty 2p orbital, so the electron enters without pairing.

prompt: Which has the higher melting point, NaF or CaO? Justify.
answer: CaO, because Ca2+ and O2- have double the charge of Na+ and F-, so the electrostatic attraction is stronger and the lattice energy is higher.

prompt: Name CH3-CH2-CH(CH3)-CH2-CH(CH2CH3)-CH2-CH3 and state the rule that decides the numbering.
answer: 3-ethyl-5-methylheptane. Both directions give 3 and 5, so the substituent first in the alphabet (ethyl) gets the lower number.
